text: On that day a fountain will be opened for the house of David and for the inhabitants of Jerusalem, to cleanse them from sin and impurity.

On that day, declares the LORD of hosts, I will erase the names of the idols from the land, and they will be remembered no more; I will also remove the prophets and the spirit of uncleanness from the land.

And if anyone still prophesies, his own father and mother, who gave him life, will say to him, "You shall not live, for you have spoken lies in the name of the LORD." And his father and mother, who gave him life, will run him through when he prophesies.
On that day every prophet will be ashamed of his vision when he prophesies; they will no longer put on a hairy cloak in order to deceive.
Each will say, "I am no prophet. I am a man who works the soil, for a man bought me as a slave in my youth."

versions.text: Each will say, "I am no prophet. I work the soil; I have been a servant on the land since my youth."
versions.explanation: The final clause (כִּי אָדָם הִקְנַנִי מִנְּעוּרָי) says a man acquired/purchased him from his youth; the current rendering ('I have been a servant on the land') blends this with the previous clause and loses the sense of being bought. A footnote could note the alternative reading 'the land has been my possession since my youth.'

text: And if someone asks him, "What are these wounds between your arms?" he will answer, "These I received in the house of my friends."

versions.text: And if someone asks him, "What are these wounds on your body?" he will answer, "These I received in the house of my friends."
versions.explanation: The Hebrew is literally 'between your hands/arms,' i.e., on the chest — a concrete image worth preserving; 'on your body' is vague. A footnote may explain the idiom.

text: Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, against the man who stands beside me, declares the LORD of hosts. Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered; and I will turn my hand against the little ones.
In all the land, declares the LORD, two thirds will be cut off and perish, but a third will be left in it.

And I will bring that third through the fire; I will refine them as silver is refined and test them as gold is tested. They will call on my name, and I will answer them. I will say, "They are my people," and they will say, "The LORD is my God."
